title: デビュー戦の後に・ぐるぐるばったん

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I made it! This isn't a dream—I actually made my debut!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I got through the starting gate, and I didn't run into the rails, and look—I'm so energetic!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I could… could… c-c-c-c—Caaaagh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto, what has come over you?! Doto! Dotooooo!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: …To be continued!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wee woo wee woo…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohhh… I'm sorry for causing all this trouble.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Geez, I nearly jumped out of my socks after hearing what happened. I'm glad it's nothing serious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The examination doesn't reveal any serious injuries. However…

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: We can scratch exhaustion and anemia off the list. Simply put, your collapse wasn't caused by fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Then… why did I faint?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: While this isn't common by any means, my conjecture would be…

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Your body, perhaps, has yet to enter the "race-ready" state.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "Race-ready…" Isn't that…

text_block_list.name: Physician
text_block_list.text: Ahem… Allow me to explain the specifics of the "race-ready" state.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Stepping out from behind the doctor, a female physician takes over the conversation.

text_block_list.name: Physician
text_block_list.text: When an Umamusume reaches a certain stage of adolescence, their body begins developing rapidly.

text_block_list.name: Physician
text_block_list.text: We refer to that period of growth as becoming "race-ready."

text_block_list.name: Physician
text_block_list.text: This is the moment the athlete within awakens, eventually reaching the peak of their capabilities. Afterwards, this peak will eventually weaken over time.

text_block_list.name: Physician
text_block_list.text: It's important to know when an Umamusume has begun her race-ready development. The challenge is, it cannot be objectively diagnosed.

text_block_list.name: Physician
text_block_list.text: The only diagnostic method is essentially instinct—the athlete themselves will have to sense a certain change.

text_block_list.name: Physician
text_block_list.text: For instance, your body may feel unusually light, you develop a very strong appetite, and you're now able to do things that were impossible for you before.

text_block_list.name: Physician
text_block_list.text: If you experience any change like this during your growth, then it's very possible you've entered the race-ready stage.

text_block_list.name: Physician
text_block_list.text: One method to confirm this for yourself is by entering a tryout race.

text_block_list.name: Physician
text_block_list.text: Usually, once an Umamusume has confirmed for herself that she's in this period of growth by assessing her tryout performance, she'll enter into an agreement with a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: If I want to know I'm race-ready… I should join a tryout.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I feel like I already have. I mean… I should have…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I did… race in a tryout, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think back to when I first met Meisho Doto, but..

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Oh, why am I such an airhead?! I skipped tryouts and went straight to my debut!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm so sorry, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I've really screwed things up. Maybe I did well in my debut… but maybe that won't continue in the future, nnngh…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: There, there, Doto… It's not that bad of a situation.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: This just means… My only choice now…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nooo, don't panic! Quitting is the absolute last thing you should—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best! Little… by little…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Since I'm not race-ready, I can't go headfirst into big races, but if I run in smaller ones…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I may be a lost cause, it may be impossible, but if I work my way up, step by step…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Then maybe, at the very least, people will recognize me as a runner you've trained. Is… that okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When it comes to not giving up, she's a league above the rest. We decide to hold back until her body appears ready.

text_block_list.name: Physician
text_block_list.text: Well, never count out the possibility of a surefire solution. It juuust might solve your worries!

text_block_list.name: Physician
text_block_list.text: And now… to unveil my disguise! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fwoop!

text_block_list.name: Physician
text_block_list.text: How about a quick poke? One for the road?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Leaving the strange "physician" lady aside, we decide to build up our racing experience gradually. If Meisho Doto increases her number of fans, her confidence should undoubtedly follow.
